phase: Ads live · day 4 — pacing recovered, review day
headline: The Aug 22 review is today — and the number to walk in with flipped overnight. The campaign that read “thin at ~$5/day” yesterday found its pace: $8.51 spent by mid-morning, tracking to the full $40/day at $0.40 a landing-page view. It’s working. The one thing still missing is a CRM wired to the funnel — without it, cost per booked call, the metric the whole test exists to find, can’t be measured.
source: Aug 21 PM brief + live FA-ADS watchdog read (Aug 22 06:35 PT / 13:36Z) + inbox sweep · Aug 22

spotlight.title: Aug 22 review — today. Read the 3-day test as a 3-day test.
spotlight.detail: Yesterday’s “tomorrow” is now. Walk in with the corrected, current scorecard: pacing RECOVERED to ~$40/day (was ~$5/day at Fri 14:00Z), CPL $0.40 — but only $24.68 spent, still well under the ~$150–200 sample floor, so treat every cost number as directional. Runway ~16 days at $40/day against $650, not “6 days”; 0 real booked calls (no CRM connected, so the deciding metric can’t be computed yet). The campaign is fine — don’t kill a working test for reading three days as if they were the verdict.

spotlight.title: Wire a CRM / booking source to the funnel — the real gap now
spotlight.detail: The watchdog spelled it out this morning: “no CRM source connected — cost per booked call, the deciding metric, cannot be evaluated.” Pacing fixed itself; measurement didn’t. Until a booking source is wired to the pixel/landing page, every review reads landing-page views and guesses at conversions. This is the top instrumentation task, ahead of the pacing question that resolved on its own. (One new raw-pixel Lead event fired Aug 21 ~9 AM PT outside the founder’s test window — unconfirmed, worth an Events Manager look, not a booking.)

spotlight.title: Friday top-up — now a real fund-or-hold, not a reflex
spotlight.detail: The $800–1,000 top-up carried into the weekend. The “topping up a stalled account buys nothing” caveat is gone — it’s genuinely spending ~$40/day now, so more budget would actually buy delivery. Weigh it against today’s review outcome and the still-unconfirmed $358 balance (w18): fund with eyes open, or hold one more day and let the review decide the number.

blockers.label: No CRM / booking source connected
blockers.detail: Cost per booked call — the whole reason the test exists — is un-evaluable because nothing wires bookings back to the pixel/funnel. The watchdog flagged it explicitly this morning. Connect a booking source before the sample crosses the ~$150–200 floor, or the review at $200 spent will be as blind as the one at $25.
